description: (K)₂NaNdBr₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight K clusters inside a NaNdBr₆ framework. In each K cluster, K is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaNdBr₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NdBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Br bond lengths are 2.89 Å. Nd is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form NdBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Nd-Br bond lengths are 2.87 Å. Br is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Nd atom.
